evidence.detail: No fixing commits found for this feature request
Current /seasons/all/metagame rolls up all seasons per archetype; no per-season-split view exists

triage.notes: This is a feature request for a new metagame view that disaggregates archetypes by season instead of rolling them up. Significant query, view, and UI work needed; the author (bakert) describes the motivation clearly (the 'one season effect') but no work has started.
